evidence.dom: **50（残余の刻み・規約3）**——全事業で提出書類自身が「集中していない」構造を述べる。『The digital payments market is highly competitive and subject to rapid change.』『Generally, our most significant competition comes from in-house information technology departments of existing and potential customers, as well as third-party digital payment processors (some of whom are our customers). Many of these companies are significantly larger than us and have significantly greater financial, technical, and marketing resources.』。発行/アクワイアリング・口座間送金では FIS・Finastra・Fiserv・Mastercard・NCR・OpenWay・Global Payments・Volante・Worldline に加え地域の小規模社が十数社、加盟店決済では Adyen・Cybersource・Fiserv 等、不正対策では『as well as dozens of smaller companies focused on niches of this segment』、請求書払いでは『Alacriti, FIS, Fiserv, InvoiceCloud, Kubra, One Inc., Paymentus, PayNearMe, Repay, as well as smaller vertical-specific providers』＝どの領域も競合が多数で、しかも最大の競合は顧客の内製。自社シェア%・上位N社合計%の開示は無く、集中を示す実数もない→ 自社が40%以上いることは構造記述から定義上ありえない＝50。『nearly all of the top 10 banks worldwide』は顧客の広さで市場シェアではない（規約4）。出典: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025（決算期末 2025-12-31・提出 2026-02-26・acc 0000935036-26-000011）
evidence.irr: **70（高摩擦移行困難）**——摩擦の機構は二つ、どちらも原本にある。(1)**複数年の購買義務**: 『Generally, customers are required to commit to a minimum contract of five years, or three years in the case of certain SaaS and PaaS contracts.』 (2)**データ移行・業務停止の費用**（基幹決済ソフトの入替）: 『For banks, intermediaries, and other potential customers of our products, switching from one vendor of core financial services software (or from an internally developed legacy system) to a new vendor is a significant endeavor.』『Many potential customers believe switching vendors involves too many potential disadvantages such as disruption of business operations, loss of accustomed functionality, and increased costs (including conversion and transition costs).』——⚠この文の見出しは『Potential customers may be reluctant to switch to a new vendor, which may adversely affect our growth.』で、会社は**新規顧客を奪う側の障害**として書いている（ONTO・ACMR と同じ「向きが逆」の型）。ただし機構そのもの（基幹決済ソフトの入替が重い）は、当社が据わっている顧客（『nearly all of the top 10 banks worldwide』）にも同じく働く対称の摩擦で、(1)の5年契約と合わせて移行摩擦の実在は原本で確かめられる。**85 にしない理由**: 顧客の側が再認定・再試験の費用を負うという断定は無く、更新時の乗換えを会社自身が認めている——『At the end of the contract term, customers have the opportunity to renegotiate their contracts with us and to consider whether to engage one of our competitors to provide products and services.』出典: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025（決算期末 2025-12-31・提出 2026-02-26・acc 0000935036-26-000011）
evidence.rep: **60（困難だが不可能ではない）**。80側の材料は原本にある——長い導入実績と規制の検査（『As a provider of payment services to banks and intermediaries, we are subject to regulatory oversight and examination by the Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (“FFIEC”)』）、顧客基盤（『nearly all of the top 10 banks worldwide, as measured by asset size, and 80,000+ merchants』）。**80 にしない理由は会社自身の記述**: 次世代基盤について『Larger or better-capitalized competitors may replicate or outpace our innovations in ACI Connetic』と複製可能性を認め、どの領域にも同等品を持つ大手が複数いる（evidence.dom）。JKHY（60）と同じ判定。出典: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025（決算期末 2025-12-31・提出 2026-02-26・acc 0000935036-26-000011）
evidence.dur: **75（スイッチングコスト型）**——堀の源泉は基幹決済処理が顧客の業務に組み込まれていることによる入替の重さと複数年契約（evidence.irr の二つの機構）。規制免許（100）は顧客の銀行が受けるもので当社の独占ではなく（当社は FFIEC の検査対象の一供給者）、ネットワーク効果（85）の記述も無い。出典: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025（決算期末 2025-12-31・提出 2026-02-26・acc 0000935036-26-000011）
